<section class="profile column-page">
  <img class="profile-photo" src="assets/img/portrait.jpg" alt="Portrait of Suniti Sanghavi">
  <div class="profile-body">
    <h2 class="profile-name">About</h2>
    <div class="profile-role">Data Scientist, Science Data Modeling &amp; Computing Group<br>
      NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, California Institute of Technology</div>
    <p>
      I work on the theory and numerical methods of polarized radiative transfer and their
      application to remote sensing of planetary atmospheres: retrievals of aerosols, clouds,
      greenhouse gases and solar-induced fluorescence from Earth-observing satellites, the
      effects of rotational and vibrational Raman scattering, and spectropolarimetric modeling
      of brown dwarfs and directly imaged exoplanets. I lead the scientific development of
      vSmartMOM, a linearized vector radiative transfer code, and am the radiative transfer
      lead of the Carbon-I mission concept team.
    </p>
    <p class="profile-edu">Ph.D. and Diploma in Physics, Heidelberg University · B.Sc. in Physics, University of Mumbai</p>
    <div class="profile-links">
